The successor keeps the body verbatim, removes the fifth field, and adds the Law 6b clause: three real documented uses of the transform (pitch detection in speech - the classic cepstrum use; rolling-centre removal in Raman spectroscopy - the use the target's own carve names as 'rolling-centre removal in spectroscopy'; bearing-vibration fault diagnosis - the documented mechanical use) and two close near-misses plainly outside the carve (power spectrum = the input domain, not the quefrency output; autocorrelation = a time-domain correlation, not log-spectrum inverse FFT). The successor is a genuine improvement in every field it touches.
